)

  FROM relay_board AS b
  JOIN ranked AS r ON r.club_name = b.club_name AND r.rn = 1

)",

  WHERE posting_state = 'posted' AND posting_day BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-30'
  GROUP BY account_code
  HAVING MAX(posting_day) >= '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT account_code, opening_units, closing_units,
